candidates_2026.party: Krajina, KDH, Konzervatívci - kresťanská únia, Nova
candidates_2026.endorsed_by: strana Dunaj (Winkler) – its candidate Sven Šovčík stepped aside in her favour; listed by SME (May 2026) in the 'Podpora Čahojovej' camp
candidates_2026.prior_runs: mayor of Staré Mesto 2018–2022 (won 2018 with 36.59 %); lost 2022 as 2nd with 22.23 %
candidates_2026.profile: Architect and urban planner, 51; former mayor of Staré Mesto, leading anti-Vallo challenger.

candidates_2026.name: Mgr. Miroslav Vetrík
candidates_2026.party: Smer - sociálna demokracia, Hlas - sociálna demokracia, Slovenská národná strana, Život - národná strana
candidates_2026.prior_runs: 2022 Bratislava mayoral (primátor) race for ŽIVOT: 1,162 votes, 0.80 %
candidates_2026.profile: Businessman, 51; candidate of the national government parties.

key_events.text: SME reports that Dunaj party candidate Sven Šovčík stepped aside in favour of Aufrichtová so as not to split the anti-Vallo vote; Dunaj backs Aufrichtová.
Five people filed candidacies for mayor of Staré Mesto, all with party backing. Four were registered.
Official list of 4 registered candidates published (dated 4 Sep 2026).

Aufrichtová filed a complaint with the prosecutor over Vagač's handling of the district-heating concession contract. She says it was signed 7.5 months after a 6-month mandate and that 1,400 households are in legal risk.

notes: This is a 2022 rematch between Vagač and Aufrichtová. In 2022 Vagač won with 50.3 % against a split field (Aufrichtová 22.2 % plus Števčík, SaNK, 16.2 %, together 38.4 %). In 2026 the anti-Vallo vote is again split, now between Aufrichtová (Krajina/KDH/KÚ/Nova, plus Dunaj) and Hitková (SaNK, the party that ran Števčík in 2022). Vetrík is the only government-party (Smer/Hlas/SNS) candidate in a very liberal district, so expect a low single-digit share (his 2022 primátor run got 0.8 % citywide). SaS backed Aufrichtová in 2022 but now nominates Vagač. Turnout trend: 43.4 % (2018), then 38.1 % (2022). No district-level polls or betting odds found. The withdrawal deadline is 22 Oct 07:00, and no withdrawals are known.

key_events.text: Švihran announced his candidacy as an independent under the slogan 'Prisadnite si'.
Councillor Peter Strapák announced his independent candidacy, campaigning on roads, cycle lanes, greenery and participation.
Three registered candidates: Chren, Strapák and Švihran.

notes: Chren is the overwhelming favourite. He won 2022 with 78.1 %, and the 2026 field is the same minor challengers as 2022 minus the Smer candidate (Jányová, 4.9 %) and Biksadská. No government-party or štvorkoalícia candidate is running. Expect a result similar to or better than 2022. No polls or odds.

candidates_2026.name: Ing. Katarína Lukáčová
candidates_2026.profile: Economist, 61.

key_events.text: Three candidates registered: Burdy (Právo na pravdu), Kuruc (štvorkoalícia) and Lukáčová (DS-ODS).

notes: Kuruc is a very safe incumbent. He took 94 % in 2018 and was unopposed in 2022. This is the first time he carries a party label (štvorkoalícia), which could cost a little among anti-Vallo voters, but both challengers are minor. Vrakuňa had the lowest turnout in Bratislava in 2022 (30.6 %). Ballot numbers follow alphabetical order of surnames, which is how Slovak law orders candidates on the ballot (confirmed against official lists for Staré Mesto and Nové Mesto, and in 2022 ŠÚ SR data). Here the ballot numbers were not checked against the official Vrakuňa list. No polls or odds.

candidates_2026.party: Team Bratislava, Progresívne Slovensko, Sloboda a solidarita, Demokrati
candidates_2026.profile: Incumbent mayor since 2022, civil engineer, 43. The aktuality.sk list spells the name 'LAMOS', while ŠÚ SR and TASR use 'Lamoš'.

candidates_2026.name: Ladislav Méry
candidates_2026.profile: Manager, 50; candidate of the anti-Vallo city party Dunaj.

key_events.text: Frőhlich Činovská launched her candidacy with SaNK, KDH, Nova and Maďarská aliancia. Ex-mayor Zoltán Pék (2nd in 2022 with 21.8 %) is on her council slate.
Three candidates registered.
Lamoš filed a criminal complaint after finding an illegal GPS tracker under his car, and reported being followed and photographed. Police opened a prosecution for dangerous stalking.

notes: This is the most competitive of the štvorkoalícia-held seats in this group. In 2022 Lamoš won with 44.8 % against a fragmented field. In 2026 the opposition is more consolidated: Frőhlich Činovská's coalition merges the 2022 Pék (Hungarian Aliancia, 21.8 %), SaNK (9.3 %) and KDH/Vereš (8.8 %) bases, together about 40 % in 2022 terms, although vote transfer is not automatic. Méry (Dunaj) splits the anti-Vallo vote. The 15 Oct stalking story may generate sympathy for Lamoš. Ballot numbers follow alphabetical order of surnames, which is how Slovak law orders candidates on the ballot (confirmed against official lists for Staré Mesto and Nové Mesto, and in 2022 ŠÚ SR data). Here the ballot numbers were not checked against the official PB list. No polls or odds.

candidates_2026.party: Team Bratislava, Progresívne Slovensko, Sloboda a solidarita, Demokrati

candidates_2026.name: Mgr. Rudolf Kusy
candidates_2026.prior_runs: Mayor of Nové Mesto 2010–2022; 2018 won with 58.49 %; did not run for mayor in 2022, instead ran for Bratislava primátor and finished 2nd with 27.72 % (SME RODINA, KDH, ZA ĽUDÍ, DOBRÁ VOĽBA, Aliancia)
candidates_2026.profile: Former long-time mayor, 50; BSK regional councillor. Reported to face a bribery charge (150,000 EUR). Spelled 'KUSY' on the official 2026 list and 'Kusý' elsewhere.

candidates_2026.name: Ing. Mária Martaus
candidates_2026.profile: Technical engineer, 48.

key_events.text: Čupka announced his re-election bid. Vallo and Droba backed him at the briefing.
Former mayor Rudolf Kusý announced an independent candidacy, attacking 'damage caused by the outgoing mayor'.
Official list of 4 registered candidates published.
Čajda (SaNK) withdrew. He complained that one candidate refuses debates and the campaign has narrowed to personal attacks, and endorsed nobody.

notes: This is effectively a Čupka vs Kusý rematch of 2018, when Kusý won 58.5 % to 37.5 %. Čupka won the open seat in 2022 with 55.4 %. In 2022 Kusý polled 27.7 % citywide for primátor, and Bratislavský Večerník (Oct 2025) reported he faces a 150,000 EUR bribery charge and lost the backing of the Dunaj party. Čajda's withdrawal leaves 3 effective candidates. Under Slovak rules votes for Čajda are invalid but the ballot is unchanged. Note that ŠÚ SR in 2022 still listed withdrawn candidates' votes with an 'X' and computed shares over all valid ballots. No polls or odds. The Kusý bribery-charge status (indicted? trial?) was not verified beyond the Večerník report.

candidates_2026.party: Team Bratislava, Progresívne Slovensko, Sloboda a solidarita, Demokrati
candidates_2026.endorsed_by: Mayor Matúš Vallo personally (launched 17 Mar 2026 at Jurigovo námestie)
candidates_2026.profile: Financial entrepreneur and co-author of the PAY by square standard, 46. District and BSK councillor, chairs the TB/PS/SaS club in the district council.

candidates_2026.name: JUDr. PhDr. Branislav Záhradník
candidates_2026.profile: Deputy mayor of Karlova Ves and Bratislava city councillor, 53. Ran for parliament on the Sme rodina list in 2023 (per SME). His team includes ex-Team Bratislava member Petra Hudáková.

key_events.text: Vician launched his candidacy at Jurigovo námestie with Vallo's personal support.
Čahojová withdrew from the Bratislava mayoral race to avoid splitting the anti-Vallo vote and did not file for district mayor, so the seat is open.
Záhradník announced his candidacy with Čahojová's backing, framing it as continuity.
Two candidates registered. Právo na pravdu's René Valent, who had announced in May, did not end up running.

notes: This is an open seat and a head-to-head proxy of Vallo vs anti-Vallo. Čahojová dominated (69.0 % in 2018, 85.5 % in 2022) and transfers her machine to Záhradník. Vallo's štvorkoalícia holds the district council majority and did not field a mayoral candidate in 2022. Long-running conflict: Čahojová vs the TB council club led by Vician, including a 2025 budget provisional regime and the Jurigovo námestie dispute. Expect a genuinely competitive two-way race. Čahojová's personal vote suggests an edge for Záhradník, while Bratislava-wide štvorkoalícia strength helps Vician. No polls found; an unscientific Facebook 'online poll' was ignored. No odds.
